description: Community-maintained MLB National League injury database tracking updates for NL stars and beyond. Data sourced from MLB.com, ESPN, Dodger Blue, LA FB Network, USA Today, True Blue LA, and other MLB media outlets.

players.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.
players.status: On 60-day IL — left fibula fracture (March 3, 2026); Rehab assignment with FCL Braves began June 23, 2026

current_injury.details: Fractured left fibula after crashing into outfield wall at Truist Park (Braves vs. Pirates). Required surgery. Placed on 60-day IL. Missed entire 2026 spring training and Cactus League.
current_injury.source: MLB.com (Mark Bowman), Atlanta Braves official communications

injury_history.details: Tore right ACL two days before the 2021 All-Star break; missed remainder of 2021 season.
Tore left ACL near end of May 2024; limited 2024 season to 49 games (.250/.324/.420, 4 HR, 15 RBI, 16 SB).
Initially returned May 19 from milder hamstring strain but re-aggravated it; placed on IL.
Re-aggravated hamstring strain; second stint on IL in 2025. Hit .251 with 7 HR, 15 SB, .793 OPS in 53 games.
Fractured fibula after crashing into outfield wall at Truist Park. Required surgery. Placed on 60-day IL. Missed spring training and Cactus League.

rehab_timeline.details: Began Spring Training at NARF. Doing regular batting practice, throwing, and running drills in a straight line, but not yet cleared for cutting drills.
Traveled to Los Angeles for final medical clearances from doctors to build up running and begin a rehab assignment.
Expected to begin outfield work and cutting/stopping/starting in the coming days. Rehab assignment likely to begin around the All-Star break.
Expected to begin Minor League rehab assignment during the All-Star break; anticipated return shortly after.
In Spring Training for 2026. Feeling 200 percent (self-described). Stole 11 bases over 16 games in Venezuelan Winter League to build confidence in surgically repaired knees.
Fractured left fibula after crashing into outfield wall at Truist Park (Braves vs. Pirates). Surgery performed. Placed on 60-day IL.
Began Minor League rehab assignment with FCL Braves in North Port, FL. First rehab game: struck out, flied out, reached on error. Rehab expected to be relatively short.

return_status.timeline: On 60-day IL with left fibula fracture sustained March 3, 2026. Began rehab assignment with FCL Braves on June 23, 2026. Expected to return to Braves' active roster in early-to-mid July 2026.
return_status.source: MLB.com (Mark Bowman, Walt Weiss), Atlanta Braves, Forbes, CrunchSports, Yahoo Sports

players.notes: Two surgically repaired knees (both ACLs). Career production when healthy: .275/.394/.462 with 25 HR and 25 SB since 2023. 2023 MVP: 41 HR, 73 SB season. The 2026 fibula fracture is a significant setback, but the rehab assignment has begun. Braves' 2026 outlook strained without their star right fielder. Signed through 2026 with club options in 2027 and 2028 at $17M each. Manager Walt Weiss confirmed Acuña will return to the leadoff spot upon activation. Braves signed Ha-Seong Kim to a $20M deal to cover shortstop in his absence.

players.name: Mookie Betts
players.status: Active — healthy, playing shortstop for the Dodgers

injury_history.details: Lost approximately 18 pounds in two weeks during spring training and early season. Missed time and 2 games of Tokyo Series. Returned after being flown home to LA.
Fractured a toe on his left foot, missed a handful of games at end of May 2025.
Scratched from game vs. Red Sox in Nashville; manager Roberts said Betts was in Nashville and expected to arrive close to game time for Saturday. Returned to lineup next day.

injury_history.injury: Right oblique strain + non-displaced right fibula fracture
injury_history.details: Exited game vs. Washington Nationals with right oblique strain. Placed on 10-day IL April 5, 2026. Hyeseong Kim recalled from Triple-A. Imaging then revealed non-displaced right fibula fracture, extending missed time beyond original oblique strain prognosis.

rehab_timeline.details: Placed on 10-day IL with right oblique strain after exiting game vs. Washington Nationals. Imaging revealed non-displaced right fibula fracture.
Spent time in LA for follow-up imaging of right fibula. Injury extended to include fracture, pushing projected return further out.
Began rehab assignment with Triple-A Oklahoma City Comets after oblique strain sufficiently healed. Fibula still healing but progressed enough for limited activity.
Activated from IL and returned to Dodgers lineup Monday vs. Giants after ~5-week absence. Went 2-for-13 with a HR in first three games back.
Stated oblique is 'behind him' and does not require ongoing monitoring. Confirmed as fully healthy and ready for any role.
Played in rehab games at Triple-A Oklahoma City, performing well at the plate.

return_status.timeline: Activated from IL on May 11, 2026 after roughly 5-week absence from right oblique strain complicated by non-displaced right fibula fracture. Currently healthy and playing shortstop for the Dodgers at a strong offensive clip.
return_status.source: MLB.com, ESPN, Dodgers Nation, True Blue LA, Dave Roberts post-game interviews
return_status.confidence: High — playing regularly with no restrictions

players.notes: 2026 season: fully healthy. Betts is 8-time All-Star, 6-time Gold Glove winner, 4-time World Series champion (most active). Former 2018 NL MVP. Lineup: batting #3 behind Ohtani, ahead of Freeman. Dodgers 26-12, tied for best record in MLB as of mid-July 2026. Oblique injuries are notoriously finicky; Dodgers' cautious approach reflects lessons from Max Muncy's back-to-back oblique injuries. Signed through 2032 (long-term).

players.name: Freddie Freeman
players.status: Active — managing chronic ankle issues; 2026 season underway

injury_history.details: Hit by pitch on left wrist during game vs. Brewers. X-rays negative. Freeman was pulled from game but returned without missing a scheduled start. Quickly cleared by medical team.

Stinger that ran from neck into right shoulder; recurring issue for Freeman. Sat out vs. Reds on Aug. 27, 2025. Expected to return by Friday (Aug. 29). Manager Roberts noted 'still some lingering effects, but nothing compromising.'
injury_history.source: AP, Dodgers Nation, Dave Roberts, Bill Plunkett (Dodgers Beat)

injury_history.details: Placed on 10-day IL in spring training with sore left foot/ankle. Moved to 60-day IL on April 1 after MRI revealed bone spur. Surgery in late 2024: ankle debridement and loose body removal.

rehab_timeline.details: Ankle surgery in early December 2024 for bone bruise and sprain from 2024 postseason. Loose bodies and debridement.
At Dodgers FanFest, Freeman stated he had yet to begin running but expressed confidence in being ready for regular season opener.
Neck stinger (cervical nerve issue) — sat out vs. Reds. Expected 1-game issue, returned by Aug. 29.
Placed on 10-day IL with sore left foot/ankle in spring training. Moved to 60-day IL April 1. Bone spur surgery required.
Activated off 60-day injured list, returning to Dodgers lineup for first time in 2026. Batted .336 with 3 HR and 11 RBI in 16 spring rehab games.
Left wrist contusion from being hit by pitch vs. Brewers. X-rays negative. Quick return, did not miss scheduled start.

return_status.timeline: Acivated off 60-day IL on June 1, 2026. Batting .336 with 3 HR and 11 RBI in 16 rehab games before activation. Currently active and managing chronic left ankle issues (bone spur history) with no current restrictions. Monitor for recurring neck stingers.
return_status.source: Dodgers official, AP, Dodgers Nation, USA Today
return_status.confidence: High — currently playing, chronic condition monitored

players.notes: All-Star first baseman. Chronic ankle issues since 2024 postseason surgery (debridement + loose body removal). Recurring neck stinger (cervical nerve) is a known issue that resolves quickly. Dodgers off day Aug. 28 helped manage neck stinger. Freeman is committed to batting title pursuit in 2025. 2026 outlook strong with .336 rehab line before activation. The wrist contusion was minor with clean X-rays. Lineup: batting before Ohtani in some configurations (#2-3). Dodgers remain one of the deepest rosters in baseball. Signed through 2024 with a long-term extension.

Began FCL rehab June 23, 2026 after left fibula fracture (March 3, 2026). Expected return early-to-mid July 2026. Fifth career lower-body injury.
last_major_developments.Mookie Betts: Fully healthy and playing shortstop. Previously sideline by right oblique strain and non-displaced fibula fracture (April 2026). Activated May 11, 2026. Dodger's NL West lead at 26-12.
last_major_developments.Freddie Freeman: Activated June 1, 2026 off 60-day IL after left foot/ankle bone spur surgery. Batting .333 in 2026. Managing chronic ankle issues and occasional neck stingers.

data_sources: MLB.com (Mark Bowman, Braves Beat; Jon Heyman; Ken Gurnick)
